name: Benierre the Axle
bio: Benierre was just an honest family man – well, and a layabout noble who picked fights with sailors for fun and profit, but only on weekends – but when disaster threatened, his magic unleashed. It was enough to save his family, if not his home. Fortunately, the Magi have provided house and duty both.
